name: compare_5m_warm
description: compare_5m for the Spark implementations only, four repeats, with the stored table read and the Python workers started before every timed fit (decisions D-18 and D-20): timings clear of what a new executor does first. From round 22 the prototype lab_spark has 125,000 rows per partition, so that at 5 million rows it has one task per core as the engine has by default (decision D-21).
